question: If A is the father of B, and C is the daughter of A's only brother, how is B related to C?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given:

1) A is the father of B

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ab72377abee149cc254803d9a485812308974c1711c153bdf82585192b6c4b2.png] 

2) C is the daughter of A's only brother

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10a35e960196e0650c3b80508d22c4ddf91f69e4394d6a82fcff1f7dfea0ff25.png] 

Here, B is C's cousin.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
